newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share trade down, Unibanka tumbles further.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share trade down, Unibanka tumbles further.

text.p: RIGA, March 27 (Rietumu) - Latvian stocks saw passive pre-Easter trade and market leader Unibanka tumbled further on continued merger uncertainties, dealers said.
Total market volume fell to 175,000 lats from 231,000 lats and Rietumu Bank's Rietumu index closed 0.24 percent down at 228.71.
"The market was rather passive today as people were trying to square their positions for the end of the month," Andreta Petersone, Hansabank-Latvija dealer, said.
Market leader Unibanka tumbled another five santimes to 4.75 lats on volume of 42,000 lats.

"It is a little bit hard to explain why Unibanka is not rising on dividend news. Most probably people are cautious, following the announcements from the privatisation agency on the need for merger with the Zemes Banka," one dealer said.
After Unibanka and Zemes Banka unexpectedly called off their merger, the privatisation agency said it had not been consulted and believed that a merger was still the best option.
On the secondary list, Kaija fish cannery saw volume of 35,500 lats but remained stable at 2.80 lats and Roja cannery jumped 42 santimes to 3.28 lats and traded 26,200 lats.

On the official list, Riga Transport Fleet added one santime to 1.74 lats and saw 25,300 lats worth of shares change hands. Staburadze confectionery fell two santimes to 2.70 and traded a small 5,100 lats.
Daugavpils Chin factory, an active secondary list stock, registered activity of 11,300 lats and stayed at 2.80 lats.
Elsewhere on the market, most shares saw small volumes, except for Riga Raugs, Liepaja cannery and Lode Brick.
Raugs traded 4,100 lats of shares and remained stable at 4.05 lats and Liepaja fish cannery also did not move from 1.50 lats on activity of 3,700 lats.
Lode fell to 2.80 lats from 2.86 as it traded 3,100 lats of shares.
-- Martinsh Gravitis, Riga Newsroom, +371 721 5240 or MARTIN.GRAVITIS@REUTERS.COM
